title: NUFORC 200250 Flight crew at FL410 observed a metallic cigar shaped object pass by as close as 5nm.
excerpt: Our old friend Ben Hansen (collaborated with Buetner from the SCU on the plane that was an orb in Suagtuk) from NFUORC has been popularising this report recently as it is on various news outlets An example new report...
content:
Our old friend Ben Hansen (collaborated with Buetner from the SCU on the plane that was an orb in Suagtuk) from NFUORC has been popularising this report recently as it is on various news outlets

An example new report
https://www.geo.tv/latest/688903-pi...-41000-feet-over-us-but-radar-detects-nothing

External Quote:

Two pilots flying a private jet over Ohio were left stunned after spotting a mysterious metallic object resembling a giant pill near their aircraft, only to be told by air traffic controllers that nothing unusual was showing on radar.

The original report
https://nuforc.org/sighting/?id=200250

External Quote:

Flight Crew observed a metallic cigar shaped object pass off the left side of the aircraft approximately 5nm away at FL430 while the aircraft was at FL410. Object seemed to be almost standing still or slowing down while passing the aircraft and the object was clearly visible as a solid cigar shaped standing on its end with no visible lights. At first it was thought to be a weather balloon but was quickly ruled as not. Air Traffic Control(Center controller) was contacted and advised the flight crew that no weather balloons or other aircraft were in the position that the object was located. After passing the object it quickly disappeared behind the aircraft and out of view.

A basic sitrec as a starting point
https://www.metabunk.org/sitrec/?custom=11433/nuforc.org 200250/20261030_110110_099de3bcef3075354fab2cc35add4cc4.js

The photo seems to be screenshot from an iPhone of a zoomed in photo, but I am unsure which app has these controls

Time on the photo is given as 20:02, so probably just before that time

Audio and video of the NFUORC video, I can download directly, but it gives me separate files for video and audio

AI extracted transcript (possible inaccurate)

  • Pilot 1: It's kind of weird, but for November 18 Yankee Papa, we saw some object on our left side, about 5 nautical miles behind of us, slightly higher than us.
  • Cleveland Center: You said you saw an object? No idea what it was, or shape or size or anything?
  • Pilot: Almost like a cylindrical looking thing, and it wasn't moving very fast, in the opposite direction.
  • Cleveland Center: How far above you?
  • Pilot 2: It must have been at like 42, 43 [thousand ft]. It was like 5 miles off our left side, heading in the opposite direction.
  • Cleveland Center: Roger. Thank you.
  • Pilot 2: Yeah, that's our first… sighting.
  • Cleveland Center: I have been instructed to give you a number to possibly call about this… this UFO. November 18 Yankee Papa, the number is (206) 722-3000.
  • Pilot 1: Alright, (206) 722-3000. This is 18 Yankee Papa.
  • Southwest 1064: Thought it was going to be a 900 number.
  • Cleveland Center: November 18 Yankee Papa, that is the correct number. Make sure you include what color the alien was.
  • Pilot 1: Roger that. 18 Yankee Papa.
  • Cleveland Center: Contact Indianapolis Center 133.77.
  • Pilot 1: 3377, 18 Yankee Papa. Good night.
  • Cleveland Center: See ya.

Note the phone number being given out by the ATC is the NFUORC number

(206) 722-3000.

https://nuforc.org/report-a-ufo/

Pilots are still being instructed to report things to a private civilian organisation with some apparent bias in it's investigators.
